title.en: Complete the two-part four-language production QA
title.zh: 完成两部分四语生产真实用户验收

purpose.en: Publish the final bilingual administrator record after completing anonymous Play and signed-in learner acceptance in production across English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian.
purpose.zh: 在生产环境完成匿名 Play 与登录学员的英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语验收后，发布最终双语管理员记录。

en: Record independent language selection, cookie isolation, Sprint reset and extension, and local-date Challenge behavior across all six anonymous Play tiles.
Record Dashboard, Course 5 skills, Sprint, SmartCard, Challenge, Everyday, Score History, Rankings, and database-resume acceptance for the signed-in test learner.
Publish per-language planned and visible persisted learning time, scores, recovery releases, and verified educational-media coverage.
zh: 记录匿名 Play 六个 tile 的独立选语、Cookie 隔离、今日速成重置与续时，以及当地日期挑战行为。
记录登录测试学员的 Dashboard、课程五技能、今日速成、SmartCard、挑战、生活口语、分数历史、排行榜及数据库续学验收。
发布各语言计划与可见持久化学习时长、分数、恢复版本及已核验教育媒体覆盖率。

en: Administrator QA documentation and release history only; this final record adds no new runtime, database, Clerk, payment, or external-service behavior.
zh: 仅影响管理员 QA 文档与发布历史；本次最终记录不新增运行时、数据库、Clerk、支付或外部服务行为。

en: Add the 2026-08-24 bilingual Project daily QA report with the complete anonymous and signed-in acceptance matrix.
Document English 2/5, Japanese 2/4, Spanish 2/4, and Italian 5/6 planned/visible persisted Course minutes and all four Sprint scores.
Document the v26-v35 defect-recovery chain, final production evidence, and 100% imageable Beginner-word media coverage.
zh: 新增 2026-08-24 双语 Project 每日 QA 报告，包含完整匿名与登录验收矩阵。
记录英语 2/5、日语 2/4、西班牙语 2/4、意大利语 5/6 的计划/可见持久化课程分钟，以及四种语言的今日速成分数。
记录 v26-v35 缺陷恢复链、最终生产证据及可图像化初级词 100% 媒体覆盖。

en: Anonymous production acceptance passed all six Play tiles, isolated language choices and cookies, Sprint reset/extension, and date-only Challenge auto-advance.
Signed-in production acceptance passed the four-language Dashboard and real-learning matrix, persisted Course and score records, SmartCard resume, Challenge, Everyday, Score History, and Rankings.

Final product gates passed 361/361 tests, TypeScript, 64 D1 migrations, production build, sensitive-data scans, changed-file lint, shared policy/architecture/base-feature gates, and 11 shared contracts.
zh: 匿名生产验收通过全部六个 Play tile、独立选语与 Cookie、今日速成重置/续时及仅日期挑战自动推进。
登录生产验收通过四语 Dashboard 与真实学习矩阵、课程及分数持久化、SmartCard 续学、挑战、生活口语、分数历史和排行榜。
最终产品门禁通过 361/361 测试、TypeScript、64 个 D1 迁移、生产构建、敏感数据扫描、修改文件 lint、共享政策/架构/基础功能门禁及 11 个共享合同。

en: Browser automation cannot reliably measure physical speaker duration. The visible and accessible Normal 0.84× and Slow 0.42× states and their bidirectional control were verified; no acoustic duration was fabricated. No required functional acceptance remains deferred.
zh: 浏览器自动化无法可靠测量实体扬声器时长；已验证可见且可访问的正常 0.84×、慢速 0.42× 状态及双向切换，没有虚构声学时长。没有必需功能验收被延期。

en: Preserve SmartLingo-only data and brand boundaries, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, and GitHub Actions to Cloudflare delivery.
No test address, verification code, email body, cookie, session artifact, payment, referral, certificate, administrator action, sibling site, or cloud configuration was recorded or changed.
zh: 保持仅限 SmartLingo 的数据与品牌边界、跟读默认关闭及 GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布。
没有记录或修改测试邮箱、验证码、邮件正文、Cookie、会话信息、支付、推荐、证书、管理员操作、兄弟站点或云配置。
